## Kyoto 5-Day Budget Trip Overview
A simple, budget-aware plan for **2 adults** in Kyoto from **2025-10-12 to 2025-10-16**.
Total budget: **JPY 180,000** → target average: **JPY 36,000/day** for the pair.

## Day-by-Day Kyoto Itinerary Concept
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg

| Day | Neighborhood Flow | Main Activities | Est. Cost (2 adults) | Travel Time Between Areas |
|---|---|---|---:|---:|
| Day 1 | Kyoto Station → Gion → Higashiyama | Arrival, check-in, Yasaka Shrine, evening stroll in Gion | JPY 28,000 | 35–50 min total |
| Day 2 | Arashiyama → Sagano | Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji area, river walk, sunset viewpoints | JPY 34,000 | 40–60 min total |
| Day 3 | Fushimi Inari → Southern Kyoto → Downtown | Fushimi Inari early visit, sake district, Nishiki Market dinner | JPY 32,000 | 45–70 min total |
| Day 4 | Northern Kyoto → Kinkaku-ji → Ryoan-ji | Temple day, garden visits, relaxed café stop | JPY 30,000 | 50–75 min total |
| Day 5 | Central Kyoto → Kyoto Station | Last shopping, souvenir stop, departure buffer | JPY 22,000 | 20–35 min total |

## Daily Activity Visualization Concept
### Day 1: Arrival + Gion Walk
- **Morning:** Arrive, store luggage, check in
- **Afternoon:** Yasaka Shrine, Maruyama Park, historic streets
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/f/f8/A199_Japan_Kyoto_Maruyama_Park_Gion_Ar%C3%A9a_%284764445344%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Yasaka Shrine, Maruyama Park, historic streets, Kyoto, Japan
- **Evening:** Gion lantern walk, casual dinner
- **Travel time:** Kyoto Station to Gion/Higashiyama: **20–30 min**

### Day 2: Arashiyama Nature Day
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/46/Arashiyama_2013-10-25_%2811096349606%29.jpg Alt=Day 2: Arashiyama Nature Day, Kyoto, Japan
- **Morning:** Bamboo Grove, Tenryu-ji exterior/garden area
- **Afternoon:** Togetsukyo Bridge, riverfront walk, café break
- **Evening:** Return to central Kyoto
- **Travel time:** Central Kyoto to Arashiyama: **25–35 min**

### Day 3: Fushimi Inari + Food Market
Media: Alt=Day 3: Fushimi Inari + Food Market, Kyoto, Japan
- **Morning:** Fushimi Inari Taisha early hike
- **Afternoon:** Fushimi sake district or nearby neighborhood stop
- **Evening:** Nishiki Market dinner and shopping
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/e/e5/A_store_at_Nishiki_market%2C_Kyoto%2C_Japan.jpg Alt=Evening:** Nishiki Market dinner and shopping, Kyoto, Japan
- **Travel time:** Kyoto Station to Fushimi Inari: **10–15 min**

### Day 4: Temple Circuit
- **Morning:** Kinkaku-ji
- **Afternoon:** Ryoan-ji, then a quiet lunch nearby
- **Evening:** Return to central Kyoto for a relaxed night
- **Travel time:** Central Kyoto to northern temples: **25–40 min each way**

### Day 5: Buffer + Departure
- **Morning:** Souvenirs, coffee, final neighborhood walk
- **Afternoon:** Station-area shopping and airport/train transfer prep
- **Evening:** Departure
- **Travel time:** Downtown to Kyoto Station: **10–20 min**

## Cost Breakdown Chart Idea
Use a **stacked bar chart** with these categories:
- Accommodation
- Local transport
- Food & drinks
- Entry fees
- Shopping / buffer

Chart data concept:
- Day 1: Accommodation-heavy, moderate food, low entry fees
- Day 2: Medium transport, moderate entry fees, moderate food
- Day 3: Highest food spend, low-to-medium transport
- Day 4: Highest temple/entry concentration, moderate transport
- Day 5: Lowest activity cost, mostly transport + buffer

## Time Allocation by Day Chart Idea
Use a **horizontal time-share chart** for each day with these segments:
- Transit
- Sightseeing
- Meals
- Rest / flexible time

Suggested pattern:
- Day 1: Transit 20% | Sightseeing 45% | Meals 15% | Rest 20%
- Day 2: Transit 25% | Sightseeing 50% | Meals 10% | Rest 15%
- Day 3: Transit 20% | Sightseeing 45% | Meals 20% | Rest 15%
- Day 4: Transit 30% | Sightseeing 40% | Meals 10% | Rest 20%
- Day 5: Transit 35% | Sightseeing 25% | Meals 15% | Rest 25%
